name: Default
shortDescription: File uploader and vault with shareable links, albums, snippets, a URL shortener, user quotas and ShareX support.

alerts.message: Log in as admin with the generated ADMIN_PASSWORD from the environment (the startup log always prints admin as the password, ignore it) and change it. Then set Serve Uploads From to https://<your domain> in the admin settings, or shared file links will not point to your domain.
